tables.name: customers
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT)

tables.name: orders
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL(12,2))

views.name: customer_directory
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_directory AS
SELECT customer_id, region FROM customers

views.name: order_summary
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW order_summary AS
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

views.name: regional_sales
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW regional_sales AS
SELECT c.region, SUM(s.total_amount) AS total_amount
FROM order_summary s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
